sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows ampicillin sodium is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
The rule-based ranking identifies Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. as the first alternate manufacturer to buy from.
Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
Civica, Inc. and Eugia US LLC are the second and third ranked alternate manufacturers, also not on the shortage list and with no placeable plant on their labels.
A prior FDA shortage posting for Sandoz Inc. ampicillin sodium injection was marked To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2025-12-08.
OneSource Specialty Pharma Limited - Beta Lactam Division (FEI 3005652193) received an OAI classification on 2015-09-01 and a VAI on 2019-02-14.
Current hospital inventory across presentations ranges from 12.6 to 27.6 days on hand.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
